1. SQL schema (migration files or schema files defining the memo table):
   find /bench/repo -name "*.sql" | xargs grep -l "CREATE TABLE.*memo" 2>/dev/null
   find /bench/repo -path "*migrat*" -name "*.sql" | head -20

Report exact file paths and line numbers for each layer.
